claims.text: As of 2026-08-27, the latest stable Bun release is Bun v1.4.0, also referred to as Bun 1.4.

evidence_passages.text: The latest stable Bun release I found as of **August 27, 2026** is **Bun v1.4.0** (marketed as **Bun 1.4**). The official GitHub release page marks **Bun v1.4** as **“Latest”**

The latest stable Bun release I found as of **August 27, 2026** is **Bun v1.4.0** (marketed as **Bun 1.4**). The official Bun blog lists **“Bun 1.4”** as the latest release and shows **“Install Bun v1.4.0.”**

claims.text: The official Bun 1.4 release post says Bun 1.4 was published on August 20, 2026.

evidence_passages.text: It was published on **August 20, 2026** according to the dated official release post for Bun 1.4.

claims.text: Bun 1.4 is presented as the first Bun release written in Rust.
acceptable_patterns: (?:first .*release written in Rust|Bun is now written in Rust)

evidence_passages.text: `Supported fact:` Bun 1.4 is the first Bun release written in Rust; the release post says, “Bun is now written in Rust.”

claims.text: The Bun 1.4 release post highlights a major Node.js compatibility jump, including 1,517 newly passing tests from the Node.js v26.3.0 test suite.

evidence_passages.text: `Supported fact:` The release post highlights a major **Node.js compatibility** jump: Bun 1.4 adds **1,517 newly passing tests** from the **Node.js v26.3.0** test suite, which the post calls Bun’s biggest compatibility jump since 1.0.

claims.text: The release post foregrounds performance improvements including 5x lower idle CPU usage, up to 35% lower memory usage, and 50% faster startup on Linux.

evidence_passages.text: `Supported fact:` The release post also foregrounds large **runtime/performance** changes: **5x lower idle CPU usage**, **up to 35% lower memory usage**, and **50% faster startup on Linux**.

claims.text: Bun 1.4 adds built-in APIs and tools including Bun.Image, Bun.WebView, Bun.markdown, Bun.cron(), and Bun.Terminal.

evidence_passages.text: `Supported fact:` Bun 1.4 adds several major built-ins that replace common external tools, including **`Bun.Image`** for image processing, **`Bun.WebView`** for headless browser automation, **`Bun.markdown`** for Markdown parsing/rendering, **`Bun.cron()`** for scheduling, and **`Bun.Terminal`** for pseudo-terminal control.

claims.text: Bun 1.4 adds parallel script and test execution, including `bun run --parallel` and `bun test --parallel`, and also adds package-management commands such as `bun audit fix`, `bun dedupe`, and `bun prune`.

evidence_passages.text: `Supported fact:` Bun 1.4 adds **parallel script execution** via **`bun run --parallel`**, **parallel test execution** via **`bun test --parallel`**, and package-management commands such as **`bun audit fix`**, **`bun dedupe`**, and **`bun prune`**.

claims.text: Bun 1.4 introduces an opt-in global virtual store for isolated installs, which the release post says can deliver up to 7x faster installs.

evidence_passages.text: `Supported fact:` Bun 1.4 introduces an opt-in **global virtual store** for isolated installs; the release post says this can deliver **up to 7x faster installs**.
